visualReview.method: Actual inspection of one representative panel per group at both widths and one full-original preview per group (33 screenshots); 24 work layouts and all 238 image slots additionally checked in DOM.
findings: All representative portraits fill equal 3:4 frames. No CSS black/white letterbox padding, obscured face, missing image, module overflow or unreadable disclosure was observed.
Each group displays the unverified-work-participation notice and collection limitation. This module has no member rating controls; reference portraits do not assert MV participation.
Original-image previews preserve source dimensions and full composition. Printed text, watermarks, backgrounds and clothing in source photos were not misclassified as added padding.
Hearts2Hearts STELLA uses a wider composition with a smaller face than peers. The original is legible and unobstructed; the source/crop remains frozen, not represented as a new close-up improvement.
MADEIN originals are 569 by 854 pixels. This lower-resolution limitation is visibly disclosed; originals are not upscaled or redrawn.
WOOAH uses the existing Catch the Stars school-uniform MV-frame collection as generic recognition only; this is not proof of the current work era or appearance.
ifeye long combined names may wrap their arrow onto a second line at desktop width; text remains legible and contained.

HITGS retains five named 1000 by 1000 originals with similar school-uniform styling; all faces are legible. The page explicitly states that a common photo session or work era has not been independently established. The final bounded-source review did not replace these images.
visualReview.screenshotMethodNote: Long panel captures use a 2400px-high viewport to avoid capturing the fixed bottom navigation through the center of an element screenshot. Interactive checks run at 1000px viewport height. No CSS was changed for screenshots.
